papers.title: Hybrid PSO-GA Optimization and Surface Morphology Analysis of Abrasive Water Jet Machining Process for Ti-6Al-4V Alloy
papers.abstract: Abrasive water jet machining (AWJM) is a precise nontraditional cutting process suitable for difficult-to-machine materials like titanium alloys. This study presents a multi-response optimization of AWJM parameters for Ti-6Al-4V alloy by integrating response surface methodology (RSM) with a hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization-Genetic Algorithm (PSO-GA). The influence of four key process parameters — water pressure (150–250 MPa), abrasive mesh size (#80–#120), traverse speed (50–150 mm/min), and abrasive flow rate (220–420 g/min) — on material removal rate (MRR) and kerf taper angle (KTA) was investigated. A Box–Behnken design (BBD) was employed to conduct 29 experiments, and the resulting data were used to develop predictive models. Parametric analysis revealed that abrasive mesh size is the most dominant factor influencing both MRR and KTA. The hybrid PSO-GA algorithm was developed and its performance was benchmarked against standalone PSO and GA. Algorithm performance metrics: convergence in four iterations, computational time of 0.3594 s, MAPE of 1.1398%, success rate of 89%. The optimal machining conditions: pressure 150 MPa, abrasive mesh size #120, traverse speed 150 mm/min, abrasive flow rate 380 g/min. Improvement in combined objective function: 7.43% compared to the best experimental run. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis of the machined surfaces under these conditions confirmed ductile erosion mechanisms characterized by parallel grooves, plastically deformed layers, and embedded abrasive particles. The results demonstrate that the hybrid PSO-GA approach is an effective and robust tool for optimizing complex manufacturing processes like AWJM.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ti-6Al-4V的磨料水射流加工参数优化，但未涉及后处理对力学性能的影响。
llm.why_not_core: No measurement of mechanical properties (fatigue, tensile) after machining; focuses on material removal rate and kerf taper angle only.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化Ti-6Al-4V合金的磨料水射流加工参数以提高加工效率。
summary_zh.method: 采用响应面法结合混合粒子群-遗传算法进行多目标优化。
summary_zh.result: 最优参数下综合目标函数改进7.43%，表面为韧性侵蚀机制。
summary_zh.validation: 通过29次实验和扫描电镜分析验证优化结果。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize abrasive water jet machining parameters for Ti-6Al-4V alloy to improve material removal rate and reduce kerf taper angle.
summary_en.method: Response surface methodology with a hybrid particle swarm optimization-genetic algorithm is used for multi-response optimization.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameters achieve a 7.43% improvement in combined objective, with ductile erosion surface morphology.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via 29 Box-Behnken design experiments and SEM surface analysis.
